# Define the end dates for the months
months_end = {
    'I': pd.Timestamp('2022-05-31'),
    'J': pd.Timestamp('2022-06-30'),
    'K': pd.Timestamp('2022-07-31')
}

# Define the start dates for the months (first day of the month)
months_start = {
    'I': pd.Timestamp('2022-05-01'),
    'J': pd.Timestamp('2022-06-01'),
    'K': pd.Timestamp('2022-07-01')
}

# Convert date columns to datetime
df['Date Created'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date Created'])
df['Date Closed'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date Closed'])

# The logic: A record is open if:
# 1. It was created on or before the last day of the month.
# 2. It was either not closed (NaT) OR closed on or after the first day of the month.

def is_open(row, start_date, end_date):
    created = row['Date Created']
    closed = row['Date Closed']
    
    if pd.isna(created):
        return 0
    
    # Condition 1: Created before or on the last day of the month
    if created > end_date:
        return 0
    
    # Condition 2: Not closed before the first day of the month
    if pd.notna(closed) and closed < start_date:
        return 0
        
    return 1

    for col_letter, end_date in months_end.items():
        start_date = months_start[col_letter]
        # Map column letter to index: I=8, J=9, K=10
        col_idx = ord(col_letter) - ord('A')
        df.iloc[idx, col_idx] = is_open(df.iloc[idx], start_date, end_date)
